english.title: Exporter of live eels fail to record details of where obtained and the catcher
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who exported live eels from England or Wales failed to

(A)_[record, in accordance with regulation 6(1) of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009, where and the date on which the eels were obtained and prepare, sign and date a certificate to that effect]_
(B)_[be satisfied that the eels obtained from an eel river basin were caught in a manner consistent with the eel management plan prepared for that eel river basin and prepare, sign and date a certificate to that effect]_
(C)_[ensure that the eels you exported were accompanied by a copy of a certificate prepared under regulation 6(1)(c) of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009, retain all certificates prepared under regulation 6 of those regulations for 12 months from the date of the certificate and allow **(..SPECIFY AGENCY..), the appropriate agency, to inspect those certificates at a reasonable time]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 6 and 28(1) of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
exporter of live eels into England or Wales failed to
record location / date eels were obtained OR
be satisfied that eels obtained from eel river basin caught in appropriate manner
and prepare, sign and date a certificate to that effect OR
ensure exported eels accompanied by certificate,
retain all r.6(1) certificates for 12 months
and allow them to be inspected by the agency at a reasonable time
